issue_request: FHIR-28450 was a Published Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking that the activityStatusDate extension be attached to ValueSet.status rather than to ValueSet and adding VSD explanatory text.
initial_application: Commit 9fca6ca36fefa544491b1efc7fdb1530333ed78b explicitly mentioned FHIR-28450, renamed the extension file and canonical URL to valueset-status-activityStatusDate, and updated the comment text, but it left the StructureDefinition context expression as ValueSet.
additional_context: FHIR-34258 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification and required removal of extension-valueset-status-activitystatusdate after ValueSet.effectivePeriod and related metadata-resource changes changed the extension's original purpose. Commit 1e011219c1eb2738181c75f2f4add7fc85e3e4c8 applied that removal in core. The remaining activityStatusDate-family artifact is a deprecated/retired FHIR Extension Pack copy under the old valueset-activityStatusDate URL, and unresolved FHIR-49169 governs that external artifact's future disposition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core build has ValueSet active, includes ValueSet.effectivePeriod, and contains no active activityStatusDate extension or ValueSet-core IG reference, so changing the historical context expression would reintroduce an extension that a later final Vocab issue removed.
